elements.text: Fireworks are the one motif. The game pays them out in the palette's colors; the UI previews one, small, on every press. The characters keep their own colors.
Firework colors — 5 palette sets + 2 cool, rare
main · light · dark per set — cream and gold are the light motif; plum is lifted (#6B3A86) so it reads on the night sky

16 designs → 8, each a different center + ring pair, picked in the sandbox.
8 patterns → 4: Shippo · seigaiha · asanoha · ichimatsu.
Dropped: plaid, stripes, dots, plain.
Press — a mini paper ring, contained
8 petals from the press point, the button's role color (action: gold + flame), clipped to its box, opacity ≤ .7, gone at 500ms. One at a time per object. Calm mode: a rim flash.

The sky: fireworks, characters, stars, nebula (exempt shaders). The UI: glow on alive things (Shape), the 4px frost on frames, leader lines drawing in, the press ring. Nothing else in the UI moves on its own. Characters keep their colors: butterfly fire, luna moth green, red string, violet glitter.

Crystal (10 sublayers, its 3×4 color sets) · HoverSparkles / ResponsiveSparkles · the 10 chiyogami palettes and firework GOLD #D9B45A · 8 designs and 4 patterns from the pool. The orb diamond becomes an AR node: thin ring, gold diamond outline.

agent.brief: Fireworks re-keyed to the palette and trimmed; one shared PressBurst for every pressable UI object; a calm flag for the game's cosmetic fx. Character colors and the exempt sky shaders stay.
rules: fireworkSpec.ts PALETTES → 7 sets {name, main, light, dark}: wine {#941E43, #FFD03B, #38194C} · ember {#E54F29, #FFF4E3, #941E43} · flame {#F88F05, #FFF4E3, #E54F29} · gold {#FFD03B, #FFF4E3, #F88F05} · plum {#6B3A86, #FFD03B, #941E43} · teal {#3DBDB4, #FFF4E3, #1D4F63} · violet {#7C5AA6, #D9C8EE, #FFD03B}. Pick weighted: each warm set 5, each cool set 2 (≈1 in 6 cool). GOLD #D9B45A → #FFD03B.

PatternKind → "plain" | "shippo" | "seigaiha" | "asanoha" | "ichimatsu", with "plain" only for ray and beads (solid: too thin for a pattern). RING_PATTERNS: petal: shippo, asanoha, seigaiha · blade: ichimatsu, seigaiha, asanoha · dot: shippo, asanoha, seigaiha · drop: seigaiha, shippo · ray: plain · beads: plain. Centers pick from the same 4. Drop plaid, stripes, dots and their draw code in drawFirework.ts.
DESIGN_POOL → 8 entries, each a different center + outer ring shape pair; the user picks them in the SilkSandbox (stop and ask, don't pick by guess).

PressBurst (shared/ui/effects/PressBurst.tsx): on pointerdown (and Enter/Space at the center), a <canvas> or SVG absolutely filling the pressed object (overflow hidden, pointer-events none) draws 8 petals (drawFirework's petal path) from the press point, radius 0 → 60% of the short side, opacity .7 → 0 over DUR.slow with EASE.exit; color = the role's --glow-color (action alternates gold/flame). One per object; a new press restarts it. Used by Button, Menu list rows, rail dots, the orb node.

Calm (reduced motion): PressBurst → border flashes to full opacity for DUR.base. Game: `calm = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")` in tuning; fireworks start at settleAt with a 300ms alpha fade; warpLayer off; glitter and embers emit × 0.25. Flight, star flames, characters, play unchanged.
Delete shared/ui/effects/crystal/** and shared/ui/animations/HoverSparkles.tsx (+ index export). gem/Diamond → an AR node: 1px signal ring + gold diamond outline, alive (glow) while dragged.
Exempt, unchanged: butterfly FIRE_* , lunaMoth GREEN_* / EYE_*, fateKnots RED, glitter violet, embers, starFlame temperatures, nebula / cirrus / Milky Way shaders.
